raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer prematurely identified Maurice Elvey (British) as the director of “Name the Man” without disambiguating between multiple films with the same title and conflicting directors shown on the very SERP (notably the 1924 film directed by Victor Sjöström). This reflects misidentification and failure to resolve ambiguity, followed by repetitive, circular searches that did not verify the alternative (Sjöström) or consult authoritative film databases to confirm which film the question likely referred to.
